description: This file implements a browser proxy command handler, managing browser control service initialization, profile validation, file reading, and request dispatching with timeout handling. It exports a main function 'runBrowserProxyCommand' that processes JSON parameters to perform browser proxy operations.

methods.name: normalizeProfileAllowlist
methods.description: Normalizes an array of profile allowlist strings by trimming and filtering out empty entries.

methods.name: resolveBrowserProxyConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration and determines if browser proxy is enabled and which profiles are allowed.

methods.name: resetBrowserProxyCommandStateForTests
methods.description: Resets the singleton state for testing purposes.

methods.name: ensureBrowserControlService
methods.description: Ensures the browser control service is started, respecting the enabled state from config.

methods.name: isProfileAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given profile is in the allowlist.

methods.name: collectBrowserProxyPaths
methods.description: Extracts file paths from a payload object.

methods.name: readBrowserProxyFile
methods.description: Reads a file, checks size, detects MIME type, and returns base64 content.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string into parameters object.

methods.name: resolveBrowserProxyTimeout
methods.description: Determines timeout duration based on input or default.

methods.name: isBrowserProxyTimeoutError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a timeout error.

methods.name: isWsBackedBrowserProxyPath
methods.description: Determines if a path is WebSocket-backed.

methods.name: readBrowserProxyStatus
methods.description: Fetches status info from the browser control dispatcher.

methods.name: formatBrowserProxyTimeoutMessage
methods.description: Formats a timeout error message with context info.

methods.name: runBrowserProxyCommand
methods.description: Main exported function that processes JSON parameters to perform browser proxy operations, including request dispatch, timeout handling, profile validation, and file reading.
